title: Total revenue by product
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on order_items, products.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
